The Palestinian Islamist movement and it: The Palestinian Islamist movement and its armed wing, the Qassam Brigades. It has governed Gaza since 2007; its political bureau works from Doha. The United States, the European Union, the United Kingdom and others list it as a terrorist organisation.
A militant Jewish group founded in New Y: A militant Jewish group founded in New York in 1968 by Meir Kahane, which grew into the Kach movement in Israel. The FBI has described it as a violent extremist group; what remains of it today is small.
A Catholic order of knights founded in J: A Catholic order of knights founded in Jerusalem around 1099, sovereign under international law without a square metre of its own since it lost Malta in 1798. It issues passports and stamps, keeps embassies with over a hundred countries, and runs hospitals from Rome.
The Tibetan government in exile, in Dhar: The Tibetan government in exile, in Dharamsala since 1960 and led by an elected Sikyong. No country recognises it as a government, and many listen to it anyway.
The Catalan independence movement's gove: The Catalan independence movement's government in exile, set up in Waterloo in 2019 by Carles Puigdemont after the 2017 referendum. Spain does not recognise it, and Catalonia is divided over independence.
